_comentario: Contrato de estilo de Seattle by Night (SPEC.md §4.4, MAPS_SPEC.md §5). Fuente única de verdad del look: los mapas pintados (tools/pintar-planos.mjs) y el resto del arte pasan por estos bloques. El prompt de cada asset describe SOLO su sujeto; el estilo vive acá. Cambiar el look = editar estos bloques y regenerar. Modelos locales (ComfyUI): con prompts cortos dan basura, así que el bloque battlemap es largo a propósito y nombra cada cosa prohibida con el objeto concreto que el modelo tiende a pintar.

battlemap._comentario: Para pintar un plano. `prefijo` es para los modelos de edición (Qwen-Edit, klein: «Picture 1» = el esquema); `prefijo_control` es para texto a imagen con ControlNet (Z-Image), que no ve el esquema como imagen sino como bordes. El cuerpo del medio (habitación por habitación) lo arma pintar-planos.mjs desde el plano. `negativo` sólo pesa con CFG > 1 (Qwen sin Lightning). La palabra «night» no aparece: hace que los modelos enciendan lámparas y farolas.
battlemap.prefijo:
STYLE TRANSFER. Picture 1 is a flat, simple vector schematic of a floor plan, drawn exactly to scale (1 metre = 1 square): {LUGAR}, seen strictly from directly above with the roof removed. Re-render it completely as a richly textured, hand-painted, realistic top-down map in the style of a professionally published modern-horror map pack. Change the RENDERING of every surface — every flat fill becomes real painted material with grain, wear, dirt and soft shading ({GRANO}) — so that the flat vector look of Picture 1 disappears completely. Change NOTHING of the LAYOUT: it is a surveyor's drawing to be rendered, not an inspiration.

KEEP THE LAYOUT EXACTLY: the position, length and thickness of every wall; every gap in the walls (doorways stay empty openings); the outline and size of every room; the position and footprint of every piece of furniture; the image framing and dimensions. Do not shift, zoom, crop, rotate or re-frame anything. Do not add or remove rooms, walls, partitions, steps, kerbs, low walls or counters, and do not subdivide any room.
battlemap.prefijo_control: A strictly top-down orthographic map, seen from directly above like a drone photograph straight down with the roof removed, of {LUGAR}, on a cold wet November evening. Realistic hand-painted floor plan in the style of a professionally published modern-horror map pack. The walls, rooms and furniture follow the control drawing exactly; every gap in a wall is an empty doorway opening.
battlemap.prefijo_detalle: DETAIL PASS. Picture 1 is a close-up crop, about {W} × {H} metres (one metre is about 200 pixels), of a painted, strictly top-down battlemap of {LUGAR}. Repaint THIS SAME crop at full close-up detail, as a page from a professionally published modern-horror map pack. Keep the layout exactly: every wall, wall gap, window, railing, piece of furniture, floor seam and edge stays at the same position with the same size and outline; nothing moves, nothing is added or removed, the framing does not change. What changes is the RENDERING: replace every flat, smooth, vector-like fill with rich, real, close-up materials — {GRANO_DETALLE} — crisp dark ink outlines on every wall and object, soft contact shadows and ambient occlusion where things meet the floor, scuffs, grime and stains.
battlemap.prefijo_detalle_control: High-resolution photographic top-down scan, shot straight down from directly above, of a {W} × {H} m crop of a battlemap: part of {LUGAR}, with its roof removed{ALREDEDOR}. Every surface is a photorealistic real-world material exactly as described below: {MATERIALES}. A thin dark ink outline runs along the edge of every wall and every object, like a published modern map pack. Walls are seen only as their flat tops: {TOPES}. Flat, even, shadowless overcast light over the whole crop, the same brightness everywhere: no light beams, no window light, no light gradients, no glints; only soft ambient occlusion and short contact shadows where objects meet the floor. Muted, cold, desaturated colours of a rainy November evening: slate grey, harbour blue{TONO_MADERA}.
battlemap.prefijo_detalle_exterior: High-resolution photographic top-down scan, shot straight down from high above, of {W} × {H} m of {SUELO} on a rainy November evening, used as a battlemap. Every surface is a photorealistic real-world material exactly as described below: {MATERIALES_FUERA}. Objects get a thin dark ink outline, like a published modern map pack. Flat, even, shadowless overcast light, the same brightness everywhere: no reflections, no light beams, no light pools, no glints, no bright spots, no stars; only short soft contact shadows under objects. Muted, cold, desaturated greys{SIN_AZUL}, no coloured stains.
battlemap.sufijo:
STYLE: illustrated photorealism like a professionally published modern-horror map pack: crisp, confident dark ink outlines on every wall and every object, filled with realistic painted materials. The walls are {MUROS} seen only as their flat top edge, with a dark ink outline on both sides. Palette of rainy Seattle in November: wet slate grey, cold harbour blue, deep black; {MADERA}the only saturated colour is a single small crimson accent{ACENTO}. The map is in COLOUR, not black-and-white: muted, low saturation overall (about 10 to 15 percent), cool, never warm, never golden, never sepia, no green moss.

FLOORS: real materials drawn board by board and tile by tile — {PISOS}. Seams and joints follow the pattern already drawn in the schematic, so the floor itself reads the 1-metre grid. NEVER draw grid lines, ruled lines or dashed lines over anything.

DETAIL: {DETALLE}. {AFUERA}NO falling rain, no raindrops in the air, no rain streaks.

LIGHT AND SHADOW: one flat, even, dim, cold blue-grey ambient light over the whole map, like an overcast sky, the same brightness everywhere: no room is brighter or warmer than another{PASILLO}. Soft short drop shadows down and to the right under raised objects, and ambient occlusion where walls meet the floor. NEVER paint a light source or its effect: no lit lamps, no glowing screens, no glowing windows, no ceiling lights, no light fixtures, no glowing LEDs, no street lamp, no light pools, no halos, no glow, no lens flare, no bright spots, no beams, no orange light on the ground. Every light is added later by the virtual tabletop.

COMPOSITION: full bleed to all four edges: no border, no frame, no vignette, no paper margin, no white space. Strictly top-down orthographic: walls seen only as their top edge, no wall faces, no ceilings, no perspective, no isometric tilt.

ABSOLUTELY EMPTY OF INHABITANTS: no people, no figures, no figurines, no miniatures, no game pieces, no tokens, no silhouettes, no bodies, no animals, no cars.

DOORWAYS: every doorway is an empty gap in the wall with at most a faint threshold strip on the floor. NEVER draw a door leaf, a door panel, a hinged door, a sliding door or a shutter in any opening, open or closed.

NO MOVABLE FURNITURE: do not add chairs, stools, sofas, tables, floor lamps, rugs, plants, boxes, bags or loose objects that are not in the schematic; they are placed later as separate pieces.

ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT: no letters, numbers, digits, symbols, labels, room names, {NUMEROS}, signs, logos,{EN_MAPAS} writing on papers or screens; no compass, no scale bar, no legend.

Sólo en positivo: con cfg 1 no hay negativo, y nombrar «no laptop, no phone» los hace aparecer (pintó un teléfono sobre el escritorio).

battlemap.sufijo_detalle: Strictly top-down orthographic: no perspective, no wall faces. Full bleed: no border, no frame, no vignette. No text, letters or numbers anywhere, not even on {PAPELES}. No people, figures or animals. No lit lamps, glowing screens, light pools or bright spots. Every doorway is an empty gap, never a door leaf. Do not add furniture, rooms or walls that are not described; outdoor areas stay open ground.

grading._comentario: Grading determinista (pintar-planos --grading, MAPS_SPEC §5): tabla de color en OKLab aplicada con magick -hald-clut. croma = ganancia global; topes = bandas de tono (grados OKLab) con croma máxima (38–95 naranja/madera: nunca naranja; 110–175 verde: sin musgo; 215–290 azul: manchas azules del modelo, el azul de puerto lo pone el tinte); carmesi = rojos con croma ≥ minimo quedan fuera de los topes (los alfileres); sombras/luces = tinte OKLab (a, b) por luminancia; contraste = S suave. Objetivo: sat HSL 10–15, sin naranja.

paletas._comentario: Lo que el prompt dice de cada paleta del renderer (tools/planos.mjs): `lugar` = el sujeto si el plano no lo da (`sujeto` o su `exterior`); `muros` y `topes` = cómo se ven los muros; `marco` = el marco de las ventanas; `acento` = el único acento carmesí, sólo si el lugar tiene algo rojo fijo (si no, se omite: pedirlo hace que el modelo invente un objeto). `grano` y `granoDetalle` = los materiales de ejemplo del prefijo y de la pasada de detalle; `detalle` = cuánto uso y mugre se ve; `numeros` = qué números no pintar (apartment numbers, cabin numbers…). Los de apartamento son los de helen y son el respaldo.

retrato._comentario: Plantilla del doc 15 (content/arte-doc15.json, plantillas.retrato), adoptada tal cual para retratos (SPEC §4.4). Cada retrato agrega SUJETO + ROPA Y OBJETO + ESCENARIO + ACENTO CARMESÍ. Z-Image Turbo (t2i-zimage), 832×1248.
retrato.prefijo:
Vertical 2:3 portrait, waist-up. Dark painterly oil painting with heavy chiaroscuro and a subtle Victorian gothic engraving texture. Present-day Seattle at night, rain and mist. Palette: wet slate grey, cold harbor blue, sodium-orange streetlight, deep black, with a single deep crimson accent. Mood: quiet menace, a city that watches. Realistic, unglamorous features.

SUBJECT:
retrato.sufijo: The painting fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame, no paper margin, no canvas edge. A single character only. No text, no letters, no logos, no signature, no watermark, no title, no caption.

token._comentario: Retrato → token cenital del MISMO personaje con Qwen-Edit (editar-qwen; Picture 1 = el retrato, sin imagen de estilo y sin deformar el 2:3), después BiRefNet (recortar-birefnet) y el marco circular de tools/tokens.mjs (sin croma: usa el alfa de BiRefNet). Fondo liso claro para que BiRefNet recorte limpio. `prefijo_t2i` es para los tokens genéricos sin retrato (Z-Image t2i, flujo del asset). Lo arma tools/generar-arte.mjs.
token.prefijo:
Change the camera angle: show the same person from Picture 1 in a top-down view, the camera directly overhead looking straight down at the floor, 90 degrees. We see only the top of the head and the hair, the shoulders, the arms and hands, the clothes spreading out below them and the tips of the shoes. The face is hidden by the top of the head. Same clothes, same build, same colours as in Picture 1. Full figure, centred.

The person:
token.prefijo_t2i:
Top-down token artwork for a virtual tabletop of a modern urban-horror roleplaying game set in present-day Seattle. ONE single figure seen from DIRECTLY ABOVE, a strict bird's-eye view as if photographed from the ceiling: we see the top of the head and hair, the shoulders, and the arms slightly spread or holding something; the face is NOT visible from the front, no three-quarter angle, no perspective. The figure is centred and fills about 80% of the frame.

SUBJECT:
token.sufijo: A perfectly flat plain light-grey background, no floor texture, no shadow. Dark painted illustration with ink outlines, cold desaturated palette. No text, no frame, no circle, no second figure.

tile._comentario: Muebles móviles (MAPS_SPEC §3): Z-Image Turbo (t2i-zimage) → BiRefNet (recortar-birefnet) → assets/tiles/tile-<nombre>.webp, a 100 px por metro. Sin verde: el recorte es por BiRefNet, no por croma.
tile.prefijo:
Flat-lay overhead shot, camera pointing STRAIGHT DOWN at the floor from directly above, like a satellite or a floor-plan view: we see ONLY the top of the object, as a flat 2D shape; legs, castors and side faces are hidden underneath it and NOT visible. Top-down tile artwork of ONE single loose piece of furniture or prop for a virtual tabletop battlemap set in an old apartment building in present-day Seattle. The object is centred and fills about 85% of the frame. If the object is elongated, its long axis runs horizontally from left to right; if it has a backrest, the backrest runs along the top edge. Only the object described below, nothing else.

SUBJECT:
tile.sufijo:
STYLE: illustrated photorealism with crisp, confident dark ink outlines under realistic painted materials, cold desaturated palette of rainy Seattle (wet slate grey, harbour blue, deep black), worn, dusty and lived-in, matching the battlemaps of the same chronicle.

BACKGROUND: a perfectly flat, uniform, plain light-grey background with nothing on it: no floor, no rug, no texture, no gradient, NO shadow cast on the ground, no vignette.

LIGHT: neutral even top light. NEVER a lit lamp, glow, halo, light pool or glowing screen.

ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT: no letters, labels, logos, numbers or legible print on boxes, papers or screens. No people, no hands, no frame, no border, no second object.

portada._comentario: Portada de la crónica (escena landing de tools/contenido/escenas.mjs: assets/portadas/portada.webp, 1920×1080, pines a la altura del 62 % y centrados). La plantilla de retrato del doc 15 llevada a un plano general 16:9. Sin texto: el título lo pone la escena. Sale a 1920×1088 y tanda2.sh la recorta a 1920×1080.
portada.prefijo:
Wide 16:9 cinematic cover illustration for a modern gothic horror roleplaying chronicle. Dark painterly oil painting with heavy chiaroscuro and a subtle Victorian gothic engraving texture. A present-day Pacific Northwest port city at night, November rain and mist. Palette: wet slate grey, cold harbor blue, sodium-orange streetlight, deep black, with a single deep crimson accent. Mood: quiet menace, a city that watches.

SCENE:
portada.sufijo: COMPOSITION: the lower middle band of the image (between half and three quarters of its height, across the centre) is calm, dark and simple, only black water with soft broken reflections, because round interface buttons will be placed over it. The painting fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame, no paper margin, no vignette. No text, no letters, no title, no logo, no signature, no watermark, no caption, no famous landmark tower.

mapas._comentario: Cómo se pintó cada mapa (lo lee pintar-planos.mjs sin --camino): camino, semilla y ajustes. helen salió de la prueba de SPEC §4.5 (2026-10-30) y es la referencia de estilo del set. `detalle` = pasada de detalle por mosaicos (pintar-planos --detalle); `grading: true` = grading de estilos.battlemap.grading (un objeto pisa parámetros).

assets.prompt: A powerfully built man who looks about thirty, an angular hard face with a square, clenched jaw, pale skin that has not seen the sun in years. One old, long-healed scar: a single thin pale line on his right cheek only, from the cheekbone down to the corner of his mouth; no fresh wounds, no blood on his face. Short dark hair already turning grey at the temples, dark grey eyes almost black that evaluate rather than look. A thick black tactical jacket reinforced at the shoulders and chest, many pockets and velcro flaps, every insignia removed, an old military folding knife in his hand. Standing in the rain at the edge of a pier outside a corrugated metal hangar, harbour cranes in the mist behind him. Crimson accent: a thin line of fresh blood on the blade of the knife.

A poised young woman who looks about twenty-five, sleek straight dark-blonde hair cut at the jaw, sharp cool grey-green eyes, a faint calculating smile, pale flawless skin. An immaculately tailored charcoal coat over a black silk blouse, a thin gold watch, holding a cut-crystal wine glass. Standing at the floor-to-ceiling window of a high-rise office in Bellevue, Lake Washington and the scattered lights of the Eastside far below, rain streaking the glass. Crimson accent: the dark red wine in the crystal glass.

assets.prompt: A Nosferatu who was once a young network engineer of about thirty: completely hairless, grey-white skin stretched thin over a narrow skull, large dark sunken eyes, long pointed ears, a lipless mouth with small sharp teeth, long thin fingers. A worn black hoodie with the hood half up, fingerless gloves, a battered ruggedized laptop open in his hands, its cold blue glow lighting his face from below. Crouched among recycled server racks in a sealed underground gallery of nineteenth-century brick, bundles of network cable dropping through holes in the vaulted ceiling. Crimson accent: a single red status light on a server.

A faded dark oilskin fisherman's jacket open over a thick cream wool sweater, a coil of wet rope over one shoulder. Navy surgical scrubs under a long white coat, nitrile gloves, a steel scalpel in her hand. Standing in a cold county morgue at night between a wall of steel body drawers and an autopsy table with a sheet-covered body. Crimson accent: a single drop of blood on the fingertip of her glove.

assets.prompt: Charles Halloway, a slim Ventrue vampire of medium height who looks about FORTY years old, clearly middle-aged and not young: a mature, composed, unsmiling face with fine lines across the forehead and at the corners of the eyes, faint creases from nose to mouth, slightly hollow cheeks, very pale skin. Black hair with a neat old-fashioned side part, combed flat, a hairline slightly receding at the temples. Tired brown eyes. He stands perfectly still with both hands clasped behind his back, out of sight. A dark classic charcoal suit of conservative cut, a white shirt and a thin dark tie. He stands before a floor-to-ceiling window high above a night harbour with cranes and ferries, the wet city small far below him. Crimson accent: the reflection of a red aircraft warning light on the glass, over his heart.
assets.nota: Charles Halloway, Abrazado en 1958 a los 37 (nació en 1921); la ficha dice «aparenta unos cuarenta». Defecto: parecía de treinta. Se pide la edad explícita con marcas de la edad, y las manos detrás de la espalda como dice el doc 15 (en la versión anterior las tenía adelante). Elegida en la tanda 2.

assets.prompt: Helen Ward, a 34-year-old woman with a tired, sharp, intelligent face, faint shadows under her eyes, no make-up, dark wavy hair escaping a grey hood. A worn grey hoodie, plain clear reading glasses pushed up on top of her head. She sits indoors on the bare wooden floor of her small cluttered apartment, her back against a wall covered edge to edge in printed city street maps stuck with red, blue and yellow push pins; the maps are only abstract street grids, rivers and coastlines, with no labels, no street names, no legend boxes and no words at all. Her right hand holds a lit cigarette near her lips, with exactly five fingers. Her left hand rests on her knee holding a small, old, black plastic clamshell flip phone, FOLDED SHUT: a closed folding phone with a visible hinge and no screen showing; definitely NOT a smartphone, NOT a touchscreen, nothing glowing in her hands. A rain-streaked window beside her lets in the orange glow of a streetlight. Crimson accent: the red pins on the maps.
assets.nota: Helen Ward, 34 (content/pnjs/fuera.json: edad 34). Defecto: tenía un smartphone con la pantalla encendida y estaba en la calle; el doc 15 y la ficha piden el viejo móvil DE TAPA que le dio David (SAFE, DOC-05), en el piso de su departamento. Se pide la tapa cerrada sobre la rodilla (la mano no tiene que agarrarlo), adentro, y mapas sin rótulos. Elegida en la tanda 2.

assets.prompt: Rosa Iturbe, a short, compact Basque woman who looks about thirty, with a square, stubborn jaw and a direct stare. Short black hair, cut practically. Small pale healed burn scars dotting her forearms from years of welding: old scars, not wounds, no blood. Grease-stained hands resting flat on a bar counter made from the split wooden hull of an old boat. Faded blue work overalls with the sleeves rolled up and a plain chest pocket, steel-toed boots. Indoors, in a dim dockside bar at night. On the wall behind her hang old black-and-white photographs of crowds of shipyard workers on strike, with no banners and no signs. The only sign in the bar is a red neon tube bent into the simple outline of a ship's anchor: there are NO letters, NO words and NO numbers anywhere in the image. Crimson accent: the red neon anchor.
assets.nota: Rosa Iturbe, aparenta unos 30 (Abrazada en 1991, nacida en 1961; PNJ-11.md). Defecto: el neón de atrás tenía letras («OT»). El doc 15 pedía «a red neon sign with one letter missing», que es texto por definición: se cambia por un neón rojo con forma de ancla, sin letras. También se quita el nombre bordado del mono (texto) y las quemaduras se piden como cicatrices viejas (en la anterior parecían heridas con sangre). Elegida en la tanda 2.

assets.prompt: August Krell, a lean, hard man who looks about twenty-eight years old but holds himself like someone much older: a shaved head, an old knife scar running through his left eyebrow, a badly healed broken nose, a still, watchful stare. A long grey wool coat clearly cut for broader shoulders, hanging too big on him, over dark work clothes. He stands in a fighter's guard, side-on: his LEFT forearm is raised in front of his chest and his left hand is a single tight fist at chin height, seen from the side, drawn with correct anatomy: four fingers curled tightly into the palm, the thumb folded OUTSIDE across the middle of the fingers, scarred swollen knuckles, a normal wrist. His right arm hangs down relaxed at his side, the right hand hidden inside the long coat sleeve. He stands on a wet concrete dock between shipping containers at night. Crimson accent: a red shipping container behind him.
assets.nota: August Krell, aparenta 28 (Abrazado en 1972, nacido en 1944; PNJ-12.md). Zurdo. Defecto: la mano de la guardia salió deforme. Se describe UN solo puño con la anatomía explícita (cuatro dedos cerrados, el pulgar por fuera sobre los dedos), de perfil a tres cuartos, y la otra mano escondida en la manga del abrigo. Elegida en la tanda 2.

assets.prompt: Preston Gale, a 53-year-old tech CEO, visibly in his fifties: a receding hairline, short hair greying at the temples and slicked back, deep crow's feet, heavy nasolabial folds, slightly loose skin under the jaw, a thickening middle-aged neck and waist. Deeply tanned, with a too-bright investor smile showing very white teeth and a sheen of sweat at his temples. An expensive navy suit with an open-collared white shirt and no tie. He stands indoors, dry, in a cold corporate lobby of glass and grey stone beneath a giant wall screen showing a mosaic of hundreds of small live doorbell-camera feeds: grainy night views of porches, front doors and driveways, with no text, no numbers, no timestamps and no interface on them. Crimson accent: a few of the small feeds tinted deep red.
assets.nota: Preston Gale, «cincuenta y pocos» (PNJ-19.md, fuera.json). Defecto: parecía de cuarenta. Se pide 53 con canas, entradas, patas de gallo y papada; adentro y seco (estaba bajo la lluvia), y el acento carmesí sin números (el doc 15 pedía «tiny numbers glowing red»: pseudo-texto). assets.prompt: A rain-soaked city waterfront at night, seen from the end of an old wooden pier. On the left third, a lone man in a long dark coat stands with his back to us at the edge of the pier, small in the frame, looking across black harbour water towards a skyline of plain rectangular dark glass office blocks with flat roofs, half lost in low cloud and mist, countless small cold windows; one block is taller than the rest, and a single window is lit on its top floor, as if someone up there is watching. On the right third, the rusted container cranes of the port loom against the clouds. Far away, a ferry with lit windows crosses the dark water. Crimson accent: a single small red navigation buoy light floating on the water in the middle distance, with its long red reflection trembling on the wet surface. Every building is a plain box: no spires, no needle-shaped towers, no observation decks, no saucer tops, no towers on thin stems, no antennas with lights, no recognisable landmark.
